name: Northern Rivers Customer-Owned Banking Scholarship (SCU)
summary: $15,000 over three years for a first-year SCU business student who lived in an area hit by the 2022 Northern NSW floods.
who: Australian or New Zealand citizen, or permanent resident.
Starting the first year of the Bachelor of Business full-time, Gold Coast or online.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a 100 to 200 word statement.
catches: The page names both Bachelor of Business and Bachelor of Business and Enterprise, so check which course with the Scholarship Office.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Northern Rivers Customer-Owned Banking Scholarship

evidence.quote: must have resided in an area that was affected by the 2022 Northern NSW floods
